result.source: Full crawl of https://www.monami.hr/ (restoran Mon Ami, Trg kralja Tomislava 26, Velika Gorica) — homepage, /o-nama/, /kontakt/, /galerija/ (+ /galerija/nggallery/page/2), /novosti/, /online-narucivanje/, plus the WordPress REST API (/wp-json/wp/v2/pages, /posts, /media), 404-probes for /jelovnik/ /meni/ /rezervacije/ /booking/ /vina/, the orphaned menu PDFs in wp-content/uploads, and the linked Restaumatic ordering platform at https://mon-ami.skubacz.pl/restauracja/mon-ami (the real live menu source). WebFetch refused verbatim reproduction, so pages were pulled with curl (note: curl needed -k on this machine — the host fails revocation checking; https://www.monami.hr also 301-redirects from http and www/non-www both resolve) and text extracted from raw HTML, so all Croatian below is byte-exact from the source.
result.summary:
Mon Ami runs WordPress 6.8.10 on the commercial "Fortunato Pro" theme (v2.0.2), brand accent #b22047, fonts Fira Sans + Nanum Myeongjo. The site is only six real pages: Naslovnica, Online naručivanje, O nama, Novosti, Galerija, Kontakt. It is a shell: the homepage's entire content body is literally `

` — the page is nothing but a parallax hero photo, logo and nav, with no headline, no intro, no hours, no menu, no call to action. Novosti is equally empty and the REST API returns `[]` for posts, so the "news" section has never had a single entry since it was created 27/03/2020. A stock WordPress "Sample Page" (id 3149) is still published. All the genuinely good copy lives on one page, /o-nama/, which carries three strong sections — "Tradicija duga 25 godina", "Ugodan ambijent", "Vaše zadovoljstvo nama je na prvom mjestu" — naming chef Goran Marko Beus, a 70-seat room, a 10-person separe, their own gold-medal olive oil from a grove in Skradin, a 60-label wine list, their own cuvée Chardonnay-Graševina from Vukomeričke gorice, and recommendations from the Michelin Guide and TripAdvisor. That page was last edited 13/01/2021. Kontakt is the only page with hard facts and is the most current (modified 02/03/2024): full address, landline, mobile, email, real opening hours, a Google Maps embed, and a Bolt e-scooter promo. Hours are stated only here and nowhere else on the site. The single worst structural failure: there is no menu page. /jelovnik/ and /meni/ both 404. Two full menu PDFs sit in the media library (Dec 2023, May 2024) completely unlinked from any page. The real, current, priced menu — 60 dishes in 11 categories with EUR prices and Croatian+English names and dish photography — exists only inside a third-party Restaumatic iframe on /online-narucivanje/, invisible to Google and unusable as site content.

verbatimCroatian: Tradicija duga 25 godina

Neka Vaša nepca dožive jedinstveni gastronomski užitak mediteranskih specijaliteta u srcu Turopolja. Kušajte naše delicije poput kvarnerskih škampi, jastoga, školjki, carpaccia od tune s crnim tartufom ili gavuna prženih na maslinovom ulju. U Mon Amiju vas očekuje dnevno svježa i divlja bijela riba, crni rižoto od sipe, jadranska lignja i hobotnica na salatu, dimljene dagnje. Uz morska jela možete uživati i u beefsteaku s roštilja u umaku od tartufate i crnog tartufa. Također, nudimo vegetarijanska i jela bez glutena.
Kušajte naše extra djevičansko maslinovo ulje iz vlastitog maslinika u Skradinu, nagrađivano zlatnim medaljama. Shodno tome u ponudi imamo hrvatske zelene masline, te čaj od maslina.
Imamo vinsku kartu od 60 etiketa, poglavito vina hrvatskih proizvođača. Također proizvodimo svoje vino kuće cuvee Chardonnay Graševina iz podregije Pokuplje, vinogorje Vukomeričke gorice.
Ugodan ambijent

Nalazimo se u središtu Velike Gorice, ali i u blizini Međunarodne zračne luke Zagreb, tako da u našem ugodnom ambijentu može uživati svatko, od usputnog prolaznika do putnika koji između dva leta želi nešto dobro pojesti.

Organiziramo tematske večere i dane posvećene domaćim sezonskim namirnicama. Restoran ima 70 sjedećih mjesta. Odvojeni „separe“ za 10 osoba namijenjen je poslovnim sastancima zatvorenog tipa. Interijer je sadržan od prirodnih materijala koji predstavljaju naš pristup življenju i poslovanju.
Vaše zadovoljstvo nama je na prvom mjestu
Mon Ami je idealno mjesto za poslovna druženja, svadbe, pričesti, krizme i krštenja.
Imamo preporuku od Croatia Michelin Restaurants – The Michelin Guide i Trip Advisora, a naša najvažnija preporuka su naši gosti.
Kuhinju vodi chef Goran Marko Beus.
Prepustite se našem osoblju koje će vas oduševiti svojom kreativnošću i ljubaznošću.

gaps:
THE HOMEPAGE IS EMPTY. The entire content body of / is literally `

` — verified in raw HTML and via the REST API. A visitor landing on monami.hr sees only a hero photo, logo and nav: no headline, no welcome text, no hours, no menu, no phone CTA, no reservation prompt. Everything below the fold is blank until the footer.

NOVOSTI HAS NEVER HAD A SINGLE POST. /wp-json/wp/v2/posts returns []. The page was created 27/03/2020 (almost certainly to post COVID takeaway news), still sits in the main nav, and renders an empty content div. It advertises a dead section on every page.
THERE IS NO MENU PAGE AT ALL. /jelovnik/ and /meni/ both return HTTP 404. Nothing in the navigation leads to a menu. For a restaurant this is the single biggest failure.

TWO FULL MENU PDFs ARE ORPHANED. jelovnik-11.05.2024.b.pdf (3.1 MB, 15 pages) and jelovnik-12.12.2023.B.pdf (4.5 MB) are both live (HTTP 200) in wp-content/uploads but linked from NO page on the site. Someone uploaded them and never published a link. I could not extract their text: both are scanned/image-based PDFs with no selectable text layer, and no pdftoppm/poppler was available on this machine to OCR them — so the PDF menu content itself is unverified. The 60 priced dishes I captured come from the live Restaumatic platform, not these PDFs, and the two sources may not agree.

THE REAL MENU IS TRAPPED IN A THIRD-PARTY IFRAME. All 60 dishes, prices, photos and allergen/vegan/gluten-free tags live on mon-ami.skubacz.pl inside an iframe on /online-narucivanje/. Google cannot index it as monami.hr content, it cannot be styled, and the restaurant does not own it. The /online-narucivanje/ page itself has zero of its own words.

GALERIJA IS BARE. The 40 NextGEN photos do load, but the page has no heading text, no captions, no descriptions — every single image has empty alt="" and a filename-derived title of "01" through "40". Zero SEO value, unusable with a screen reader, and split across two paginated pages instead of a modern lightbox grid.
COPYRIGHT FROZEN AT 2020. The footer on every page reads "Copyright © 2020 Monami" — six years stale, and the first thing that signals abandonment to a visitor.

"TRADICIJA DUGA 25 GODINA" IS OUT OF DATE. That heading was written on a page last modified 13/01/2021. If it was accurate then, the correct figure now is roughly 30 years. The restaurant is undercounting its own history.

OPENING HOURS APPEAR ON EXACTLY ONE PAGE. Hours exist only in a paragraph on /kontakt/. They are absent from the homepage, absent from the footer, and absent from any structured data — so Google has nothing authoritative to read.

NO RESERVATION SYSTEM AND NO BOOKING PAGE. /rezervacije/, /rezervacija/ and /booking/ all 404. The only way to book is to read a phone number off the Kontakt page. For a 70-seat restaurant that hosts weddings, communions and business dinners, there is no enquiry form anywhere on the site.
LANG ATTRIBUTE IS WRONG. The document declares <html lang="en-US"> on every page while the content is Croatian. This hurts SEO and accessibility.

NO META DESCRIPTION AND NO OPEN GRAPH TAGS on the main site. Search snippets are auto-generated and any link shared to Facebook, WhatsApp or Viber renders with no title card, no description and no image.
NO STRUCTURED DATA. There is no schema.org Restaurant markup — no address, hours, price range, menu, geo or acceptsReservations. Google cannot build a rich result.
A STOCK WORDPRESS "SAMPLE PAGE" IS STILL PUBLISHED (page id 3149, /sample-page/, created 28/01/2019, never touched). Default WordPress boilerplate live on a commercial site.

EVERY INNER PAGE USES A BLACK PLACEHOLDER AS ITS HEADER. O nama, Kontakt, Galerija, Novosti and Online naručivanje all load /2020/02/black.jpg stretched to 1920x99999 as the masthead background. Only the homepage has a real photo. Five of six pages open on a black rectangle.

AN UPLOADED HERO IS GOING UNUSED. bg3D3-08-24.jpg (Aug 2024) is the newest image in the media library, but the homepage still serves bg3D3-03-24.jpg — someone uploaded a refresh and never switched it over.
SITE IS EFFECTIVELY DORMANT. Newest media upload is Aug 2024; homepage last modified 26/08/2024; O nama untouched since 13/01/2021. Roughly two years without a content change.

PERFORMANCE IS POOR. 40 unoptimised gallery JPEGs at 500-900 KB each, a ~600 KB hero, no WebP/AVIF anywhere, full jQuery plus jquery-migrate, render-blocking Google Fonts, plus a full-screen preloader animation that delays first paint.

ONLY ONE SOCIAL CHANNEL. Facebook alone (facebook.com/monamihr). No Instagram link despite this being a seafood restaurant with strong plating — and no link out to the TripAdvisor or Michelin Guide listings the O nama text explicitly boasts about.
FREE GMAIL ADDRESS. Contact is monamihr@gmail.com rather than something like info@monami.hr, which undercuts credibility at this price point (beefsteak €42, scampi €96/kg).

MIXED AND BROKEN LANGUAGE. The Kontakt page drops an untranslated English paragraph starting "NEW: For airport travelers..." containing typos ("aproximately", "bus lines that drives") into otherwise Croatian copy. The nav says "Naslovnica" but the page's own H1 is the English word "Home". On the ordering platform, English names are wrong or missing ("Istarski fuži s beefsteakom i crnim tartufom" is translated as "Beefsteak salad"; several dishes have no English at all; "Mesna plata" has a Croatian string in the English field; typos "Prshutto", "french frie", "homemaid", "cackerels", "bouzzara"). There is no real language switcher.

SEAFOOD PRICES ARE AMBIGUOUS AND ALARMING AS DISPLAYED. "Jadranske lignje sa žara €62,00", "Škampi sa žara (8-12kg) €96,00", "Školjke na buzaru €63,00" are almost certainly per-kilogram prices, but nothing on the ordering page says so. As shown they read as the price of a single portion. The "(8-12kg)" grading notation will be meaningless to most guests.

NO OWNER OR TEAM PRESENCE. Chef Goran Marko Beus is named in one sentence with no photo and no bio. No owner is named anywhere. No staff photography. For a restaurant selling a 25-year family tradition, there is no human face on the site.

CLAIMS ARE UNVERIFIED AND UNLINKED. The Michelin Guide and TripAdvisor recommendations and the olive oil's "zlatne medalje" are asserted in prose with no logos, no links, no award body named and no year given. I could not confirm any of them from the site itself.

NO COOKIE BANNER DESPITE A COOKIE POLICY. /cookie-policy-eu/ exists (HTTP 200, created Oct 2023) but is not linked from the footer or nav, and I found no consent plugin (no Complianz/cmplz/cookie-law markup) loading on the pages — while a Google Maps iframe is embedded on Kontakt. Likely a GDPR gap, though I did not audit this exhaustively.

NAV LINKS ARE INCONSISTENT. Four of six menu items (/o-nama, /novosti, /galerija, /kontakt) omit the trailing slash while the canonical URLs include it, forcing an extra redirect on most navigation clicks.

I COULD NOT ASSESS ACTUAL MOBILE RENDERING. A responsive viewport meta tag and a Fortunato Pro hamburger toggle (.menu-toggle, breakpoint 1025px) are present, so the theme is nominally responsive, but I had no browser or screenshot capability here — I cannot confirm how the parallax hero, the 240x160 gallery grid, or the embedded Restaumatic ordering iframe actually behave on a phone. The iframe-in-a-page ordering flow is the most likely mobile problem.

I COULD NOT VERIFY DELIVERY TERMS. The ordering platform renders its delivery zone, minimum order, delivery fee and current open/closed status client-side via JavaScript, so none of that was in the fetched HTML. Whether delivery is still active at all is unconfirmed.

NO DRINKS OR WINE LIST ONLINE. The O nama text boasts a 60-label wine list and a house cuvée, but /vina/ 404s and the ordering platform carries no beverage categories at all. Not one wine, and not one price for one, is published anywhere on the site.

SITE AUTHORSHIP SUGGESTS AN ABSENT CONTRACTOR. Every page is authored by the account "mpecko" with a public author archive at /author/mpecko/. This looks like an external web developer rather than restaurant staff, which likely explains why nothing has been updated since 2024 — but I could not confirm who mpecko is.

TLS/CERTIFICATE WARNING. Fetching https://www.monami.hr from this machine failed certificate revocation checking (CRYPT_E_NO_REVOCATION_CHECK) and required curl -k to proceed. This may be a local Windows/schannel quirk rather than a genuine server fault, but it is worth testing the certificate chain (and any missing intermediate) during the rebuild.
